valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the only statements on file for Eveready East Africa are FY2021 and FY2020, five years older than the current 2026 market price, and the period reports no net profit. A multiple pairing a 2026 price with a closed, stale period is not a valuation of the listed company. A blank is honest.

A blank is honest; a ratio carried forward from a stale, closed-period file is not a valuation.
